Editor's note: this section has been amended by L.L. 2026/042, 1/17/2026, eff. 1/1/2027.
Every owner of elevators and other devices shall pay to the department a report filing fee for each elevator or device in the amount prescribed by the department's rules.
(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
